analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($239,500) vs SMA5/20/50 ($227,500/$259,050/$298,600) — below SMA20/50, indicating short-term weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($258,118/$193,439) — below SMA100, suggesting medium to long-term weakness.
· 52-week position (57.1%) + current price level is historically in the middle range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.3→44.3) + staying neutral, showing weak recovery.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2519.1856→-1134.5676) + improving, maintaining bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $259,050) + band width is relatively wide at 41.34%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($167,300) + based on Pivot S1 ($177,467).
· Swing resistance level ($370,000) + Bollinger Upper Band ($312,591) acts as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + trend reversal uncertainty.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.59x) + low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + confirmation of conditions for observation.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 탐색 중. MACD 히스토그램 개선은 긍정적이나, 거래량 부재로 추세 전환 신뢰도는 낮음.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is consolidating around the Bollinger Band middle line, searching for direction. While the MACD histogram improvement is positive, the lack of volume lowers confidence in a trend reversal.
keyPoints: RSI가 중립 구간에서 44.3으로 소폭 상승했으나, 여전히 과매도 구간 탈출 신호는 약함.
MACD 히스토그램이 개선되며 약세 수렴을 이어가고 있어, 추가 하락보다는 바닥 다지기 가능성에 무게.
거래량 비율이 0.59로 위축되어 있어, 현재 가격 움직임은 신뢰도가 낮으며 방향성 확정은 어려움.
keyPointsEn: RSI has slightly increased to 44.3 in the neutral zone, but the signal for exiting oversold territory remains weak.
The MACD histogram is improving while maintaining bearish convergence, suggesting potential bottoming rather than further decline.
The trading volume ratio is subdued at 0.59, indicating low confidence in current price movements and difficulty in confirming a direction.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 27.3으로 추세가 형성되고 있으나, -DI(31.7)가 +DI(20.2)보다 높아 하락 압력이 우위에 있어 추세 전환은 신중해야 함.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX at 27.3 indicates a trend is forming, but with -DI (31.7) higher than +DI (20.2), downward pressure is dominant, requiring caution for trend reversal.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 금일도 RSI 중립 유지 및 MACD 약세 수렴 지속, 거래량 위축으로 인해 관망세를 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today, maintaining a wait-and-see stance due to RSI remaining neutral, continued bearish MACD convergence, and subdued volume.
